text: A storm-fed spirit on tall slate wings marked with lightning. A bright gathering of motes warns of its gust.
Hunted, it also drops up to 2 String and up to 1 Phantom Membrane.
Storm Moths fly over the March Highlands, the Snow Fields and the Glimmer Ridge, and a few over the Ember Wastes.
It has **20 health** and no armour. It hangs back and casts a gust from up to 12 blocks away: **4 damage** and a strong push. Break its line of sight and the spell fails.
pages.title: Where and how

text: A Storm Wing binds into 2 Spiritweave under Water.
pages.title: What it gives

text: Reach **Voice** with the **Pattern-weavers**, then use a Bonding Charm on an adult: two tries in five, charm spent on failure. Or feed it its own reagent: one try in five, and the reagent is spent either way.
A bonded moth that sits leaves a small invisible click of redstone once a second, a free clock for your contraptions. See [familiar gifts](familiar_gifts).
pages.title: As a familiar
Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, it drops this when hunted, more with Looting.
